\begin{quote}
\textbf{3.6.} Consider a first-price, sealed-bid auction in which the bidders' valuations are independently and uniformly distributed on \([0,1]\). Show that if there are \(n\) bidders, then the strategy of bidding \((n-1)/n\) times one's valuation is a symmetric Bayesian Nash equilibrium of this auction.
\end{quote}
